attributes.action: Introduce Paid Menstrual Health Leave and Reform Sickness Absence Policies
attributes.additional_details: Women with chronic reproductive health conditions can experience debilitating pain, fatigue and unpredictable symptoms that affect their ability to work. They should not have to sacrifice annual leave, income or job security to manage their health. We propose up to five additional paid working days per month, without sickness penalties. We also call for fairer attendance monitoring based on the percentage of working days missed, rather than disproportionate Bradford Factor scores.
attributes.background: We urge the UK Government to introduce up to 5 days of additional paid leave per month for debilitating women’s health conditions, including endometriosis, fibroids, PCOS, adenomyosis and PMDD, and reform sickness policies to prioritise percentage-based monitoring over the Bradford Factor.
